edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the total settlement amount of $[●] (the “Settlement Amount”). Defendant shall pay the Settlement Amount within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date and receipt from Plaintiff of a completed Form W-9 and written wire or mailing instructions. Payment shall be made by wire transfer or other mutually agreed method. Plaintiff acknowledges that Defendant will issue any tax reporting forms it determines are required by applicable law, and Plaintiff is solely responsible for any taxes, penalties, or interest arising from receipt of the Settlement Amount.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. MUTUAL RELEASES. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff, on behalf of Plaintiff and Plaintiff’s agents, representatives, successors, and assigns, fully and forever releases and discharges Defendant and its present and former affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, representatives, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, liabilities, costs, and expenses, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters alleged or that could have been alleged in the dispute through the Effective Date. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Defendant, on behalf of Defendant and its present and former affiliates, successors, and assigns, releases Plaintiff and Plaintiff’s agents, representatives, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, liabilities, costs, and expenses, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters alleged or that could have been alleged in the dispute through the Effective Date. Nothing in this Agreement releases or waives any party’s rights or obligations under this Agreement, including any claim to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Mutual Releases

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms and existence of this Agreement confidential and shall not disclose them except: (a) to a party’s spouse, immediate family members, attorneys, tax advisors, financial advisors, accountants, insurers, auditors, or other professional advisors, provided that the disclosing party informs such recipients of the confidential nature of the information; (b) to taxing authorities; (c) as required by applicable law, court order, subpoena, regulation, or legal process, provided that the disclosing party gives the other party prompt written notice to the extent legally permitted; (d) as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement; or (e) by mutual written agreement of the parties. The parties agree that any disclosure permitted under this Section shall be limited to the extent reasonably necessary for the permitted purpose.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO DISPARAGEMENT. The parties agree not to make, publish, or communicate to any person or entity any false or disparaging statement concerning the other party or, as applicable, the other party’s affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, representatives, successors, or assigns. Nothing in this Section prohibits truthful statements required by law, court order, subpoena, regulation, or legal process; communications with legal, tax, financial, or other professional advisors; or statements reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: No Disparagement

edits.text: 5. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is a compromise of disputed claims and is not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: No Admission
